description: This file contains CMake functions and macros for configuring header-only library installations, including generating config files and package configuration files, with support for templates, dependencies, and installation paths.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a CMake configuration for a header-only library target, handling dependencies, templates, and versioning.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config file for a header-only library, including setting up include directories, compile options, and linking information.
